text: Ndee Alqur'aaaare jippinaande e Muhammadu (yo o his) ko nulal Alla e yimɓe ɓen, e fii yo ɓe hulu kammbaaji mayre tiiɗuɗe, e no ɓe anndirar ewetee- ɗo e goonga alaa si wanaa Alla Gooto On, ɓe rewa Mo hara ɓe kafidaali Mo e goɗɗo goo, e no joomi- raaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɓen waajitora nde ɓe taskoo, tawde ko kamɓe nafitorta waaju mayre.
